title: In situ confinement of ultrahigh-density Co2P nanoparticles within biomass-derived carbon nanosheet frameworks as efficient cocatalysts for solar H2 production
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00112A, Communication
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Fang Wang, Junqing Wang, Jiao Zhang, Yiming Li, Zhengguo Zhang, Shixiong Min
An efficient and versatile H2 evolution cocatalyst is developed by embedding ultrahigh-density Co2P nanoparticles within biomass-derived carbon nanosheets, exhibiting high activity and stability in both the dye-sensitized and semiconductor systems.
